text:
elsa: hi team, onboarding question: setting up CI to call hosted API. where do i get dev sandbox keys, can i make ephemeral ones for PR builds, and what are safe quotas so our CI won't trigger rate limits?

devex: welcome! Console -> API Keys to create keys. choose Ephemeral for short-lived CI keys (1-8h). default sandbox quotas are conservative (roughly 50-100 reqs/min, low concurrency). if you need higher for a short window, use Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests and include project id + window.

elsa: thanks. i want to run parallel PR checks (5 runners) each doing few calls, responses ~300 tokens. should i request a bump?

infra-ops: 5 runners x small calls usually ok, but include expected rps in the request if you plan bursts. we can approve temporary allowlist for CIDR or raise per-project limits for a scheduled window. also please scrub logs and use CI secret store for REDWOOD_API_KEY.

mike: tip: set max_tokens in payload and pin model to avoid routing surprises. handle 429s with exponential backoff and respect Retry-After header.

onboarding-bot: checklist reminder: "Create ephemeral sandbox key" and "Request sandbox quota" if needed for @elsa.

elsa: got it  created ephemeral key (expires 4h), updated CI secrets, filed quota request for a 1-hour bump starting 1768927200 UTC. will monitor. thanks!
